title: croton velleriflorus
intro: Croton velleriflorus, commonly known as the bush mango or African bush mango, is a plant species in the family Euphorbiaceae. It is native to the tropical regions of Africa and has been used in traditional medicine for various health benefits. The health benefits of Croton velleriflorus include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which help in reducing oxidative stress, inflammation, and infection. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-diarrheal, and anti-hypertensive effects.
